sources.title: Receipt processing prebuilt AI model - AI Builder | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: Receipt processing is a prebuilt model that uses state-of-the-art optical character recognition (OCR) to detect printed and handwritten text and extract key information from receipts.

sources.title: Receipt data extraction - Document Intelligence - Foundry Tools
sources.snippet: The Document Intelligence receipt model combines powerful Optical Character Recognition (OCR) capabilities with deep learning models to analyze and extract key information from sales receipts. Receipts can be of various formats and quality including printed and handwritten receipts.
